extra.message: The attacker-controlled username query parameter is concatenated into Jinja2 template source and rendered. Injected Jinja2 expressions are evaluated server-side, enabling server-side template injection and potentially arbitrary code execution.

cwe: CWE-1336: Improper Neutralization of Special Elements Used in a Template Engine

extra.message: Rendered output containing the attacker-controlled username is returned as text/html. Because the Jinja2 Environment has autoescaping disabled by default, injected HTML or JavaScript is returned unescaped, enabling reflected cross-site scripting.

cwe: CWE-79: Improper Neutralization of Input During Web Page Generation
